ECR1.1.label: Correction to a published record
ECR1.1.description: Definition: A publisher, author or editor asks for the metadata of a specific existing record to be updated to match the published version: author names, affiliations or emails, the title including a RETRACTED prefix, the abstract, the DOI, the publication date or source details.

ECR2.label: Indexing error or data quality problem

ECR2.1.label: Indexing error or data quality problem
ECR2.1.description: Definition: A user or colleague reports that records are indexed or rendered wrongly: missing or wrong Emtree, drug, device or brand-name terms, wrong keyword headings, garbled abstracts, typographical errors, duplicate records, or a suggestion for a new Emtree term.

ECR3.label: Missing article or record not yet indexed

ECR3.1.label: Missing article or record not yet indexed
ECR3.1.description: Definition: A specific article, issue or conference paper is not in Embase or not fully loaded yet, and the customer asks for it to be added or when it will appear.

ECR4.label: Journal coverage, evaluation or indexing status

ECR4.1.label: Journal coverage, evaluation or indexing status
ECR4.1.description: Definition: Questions about a JOURNAL rather than a record: applying or suggesting a journal for inclusion, the evaluation or indexing status of a journal, discontinued or cancelled titles, complaints about the quality or integrity of an indexed journal, or journal lists.

ECR5.1.label: Organisation access set-up or entitlement
ECR5.1.description: Definition: An administrator, librarian or account manager asks about access for an organisation: activating a subscription, trial or Embase AI for an account, IP ranges, SSO, OpenAthens or Shibboleth configuration, API or developer credentials, consolidating accounts, or whether an institution subscribes.

ECR6.1.label: User cannot access Embase
ECR6.1.description: Definition: An individual cannot get into Embase through their institution or subscription: access via IP, VPN, OpenAthens or campus network fails, access is blocked with an error code, or a trial or paid access does not open.

ECR7.1.label: Error message or technical fault
ECR7.1.description: Definition: Embase or Embase AI misbehaves: search errors, pages or record details that will not load, error codes, a cookie banner that cannot be accepted, or browser-specific failures.

ECR8.label: Search, export or product feature question

ECR8.1.label: Search, export or product feature question
ECR8.1.description: Definition: How to do something in Embase: building searches and search strategies, sources and filters, exporting or emailing records, alerts, linking to full text, or how a feature works.

ECR9.1.label: Feedback or feature request
ECR9.1.description: Definition: The customer comments on the interface or asks for a change: complaints about the new results page or search bar behaviour, or requests for new options such as a citation style.

ECR10.label: Usage report or usage data request

ECR10.1.label: Usage report or usage data request
ECR10.1.description: Definition: A request for Embase usage statistics or reports for an account, or questions about usage figures.

ECR11.1.label: Order, purchase, renewal or invoice
ECR11.1.description: Definition: Buying Embase or asking about prices and plans, orders and payment problems, invoices, renewals, subscription dates, terms, or cancelling a subscription.

ECR12.1.label: Other / not enough information
ECR12.1.description: Definition: The ticket carries no request that fits the categories above: a duplicate pointing to another incident, a thank-you, an auto-reply or spam, an agent-only note, or too little text to tell.
